snippet.title: Silver and Blood Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
"Then tell me, when do you think a person truly dies? When the heart stops beating? When they can no longer think?"
"Or, perhaps when they are forgotten by the world?"

"In this war of Silver and Blood... who will be the victor?"

📺Welcome to the World of Silver and Blood!
English Voice Cast: Keith Silverstein, Chris Hackney
Original Sounds: Yasunori Nishiki

The Silver and Blood trailer is here!
